map.几何平均数计算器：输入数值集合，按乘积的 n 次根计算几何平均数，适合增长率、比: Geometric mean calculator: enter a set of numbers and compute the geometric mean as the n-th root of the product, suitable for measuring the central tendency of growth rates, ratios and other multiplicative data.
map.n 个数乘积开 n 次方：g=(Πx_i)^(1/n)。: The n-th root of the product of n numbers: g = (product of x_i)^(1/n).
map.对极端值比算术均稳健。: More robust than the arithmetic mean against extreme values.
: Annual growth rates 5%, 10%, -2%: convert to 1.05, 1.10, 0.98; g = (1.05 x 1.10 x 0.98)^(1/3), about (1.1319)^(0.333), about 1.0423, that is a compound annual rate of about 4.23%.
map.为何增长率用几何均？: Why is the geometric mean used for growth rates?
map.增长率复利相乘，几何均给出复合均值；算术均会高估（如 +50% 后 −50% 不: Growth rates compound multiplicatively, and the geometric mean gives the compound average; the arithmetic mean overstates (for example +50% then -50% is not a 0% return).
map.几何均要求全为正，含零或负无意义（或需平移），比率常用对数后算算术均再指数化。: The geometric mean requires all values to be positive; zeros or negatives make it meaningless (or require shifting). For ratios it is common to take logs, average them and then exponentiate.
